story_text: As an authenticated user, I want to update my dashboard settings so I can customize the workspace.

explicit_ACs.text: The settings page shall show the current notification preference
The settings page shall allow a user to change notification preferences
The settings page shall save changes on submit
The settings page shall show a success message after saving

implicit_ACs.text: The settings page shall include a cancel action
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Forms typically include a cancel option

implicit_ACs.text: The settings page shall preserve unsaved changes when navigating away
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Unsaved form state should be protected

implicit_ACs.text: The settings page shall highlight unsaved fields
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Users need visual feedback before leaving a form
